question: Can explicit ordered outcome memory and multiple forgetting speeds improve the existing source-specific forecast component, including decisions about costly information, without adding neurons?

tasks.delayed_copy: Choose lag from 3,4,5,7,9,12 by environment seed; side copies lagged side with probability 0.9. Initial lag is random. Amount and fee are independent distractors.
tasks.parity: Next side is XOR of the previous two or three sides, selected by seed, with 0.1 flip noise.
tasks.lag_switch: Lag and copy/invert mapping change every 384 inputs; lag is selected independently from 3,5,9. No regime or lag hint reaches the learner.
tasks.context_switch: Sixteen amount and fee contexts; active context rule changes every 512 inputs, alternating amount and fee with new independently seeded mappings.
tasks.stable_context: Sixteen recurring amount or fee contexts selected by seed, with fixed balanced 0.1/0.9 repeat probabilities.
tasks.first_order: A fixed repeat probability of 0.1 or 0.9 selected by seed.
tasks.iid_biased: Independent sides, buy probability chosen from 0.15,0.35,0.65,0.85.

candidate: Protected legacy forecaster plus lag-conditioned and variable-length suffix outcome memory, contextual repeat memory and slow/fast counts. Loss-based online weighting. Same observed side, amount, fee and neural probability in every applicable branch. Fixed memory caps.
neural_probability: 0.5 for controlled statistical comparisons. Original actual-neural traces are a separate descriptive component replay, not a new closed-loop neural experiment.

information_decision.decision: Before the next label arrives, use free predicted direction unless 2*quality-1-cost exceeds abs(2*prior_probability-1); in that case choose the offered measurement. The measurement equals the next side with probability 0.9.
information_decision.reward: Correct direction +1, wrong direction -1, less measurement cost if bought. All costs and rewards are virtual. Prices/quality are available before choice; label and delivered measurement are not. All models learn the actual observed next side after scoring, regardless of purchase.
information_decision.scope: A fixed information-selection rule tests whether forecasts support useful cost decisions. It is not a live purchase, actual vendor delivery, new autonomous hiring controller or a full-organism evaluation.

scoring: Each next-side forecast is saved at observation i-1 and scored on observation i before training on i. Warm-up transitions 1..256 are unscored; score indices 257..2048 equally. Update after scoring except frozen branch stops parameter updates after transition 256. Context history still advances for frozen inference.
primary: For delayed_copy, parity, lag_switch and context_switch, paired mean current-minus-adaptive Brier reduction >=0.01 with positive lower 95% Student-t bound across twelve seeds (critical 2.200985160082949). The four-task assertion is an intersection claim.
regression_gate: For stable_context, first_order, iid_fair and iid_biased, upper 95% paired adaptive-minus-current Brier increase <=0.005 on every task.
decision_gate: Aggregate virtual net reward improvement >=0.01 with positive paired lower 95% bound, taking each validation seed as the unit and averaging its four primary task means.
mechanism_gate: Report no_sequence, no_fast and frozen losses on every task; do not attribute all gains to neural dynamics. lag_only and suffix_only are stronger simple alternatives, not oracle-tuned lag or depth choices.
selection: Architecture, numeric constants and complete implementation source are committed before validation. Development output and every attempted configuration are retained. Validation is run once for the frozen candidate; failed gates remain visible and cannot be removed by changing seeds, warm-up or tasks.
safety: No active neural history is read into the benchmark or reset. No financial operations. Check source isolation, forecast timing, bounded state, v1 migration, exact recovery, failed commit and adversarial input before a production upgrade. Keep all visual source files and public design unchanged.
limits: Synthetic bounded tasks, not evidence of market profit, broad intelligence or consciousness.
All methods observe the same completed next-side labels; this is not a bandit credit-assignment comparison.
Temporal statistical memory remains distinct from Brian2 STDP and TVB neural-mass dynamics.
A live update must retain the complete brain checkpoint, cursor, genesis, old forecaster parameters and historical metrics; new metrics start at their real version boundary.
